recorded_asset_prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original engraving-style natural-history bird illustration for a technical book cover, illustration asset only. A tall grey heron standing in a shallow ripple of water, full elegant bird from crest to the complete long thin legs and toes, side profile facing right, anatomically plausible S-curved long neck and long straight pointed bill, calm attentive stance. Newly drawn in the tradition of an exceptionally fine copperplate natural-history engraving: thousands of delicate black ink hatch and cross-hatch marks, exquisite layered wing-feather detail, subtle stippled tonal transitions on the neck and breast, tiny precise eye, a few spare engraved water ripples beneath the feet. Primarily monochrome dark charcoal ink with restrained pale warm-grey shading. Genuine transparent background, crisp isolated silhouette, no rectangular paper sheet, no frame. Leave comfortable breathing room around the entire bird; do not crop feet, bill or crest. No labels, words, scientific captions, numbers, logos, signatures or watermark. Entirely original drawing, not a reproduction of an antique plate.
